tasks.invariant: Every enabled command has one selected economic owner and a complete user-to-terminal contract.
tasks.authority_boundary: Specifications select semantics. Research tools may propose choices and cannot select production policy.
failing_evidence: The exact V1 source has 33 commands and 8 research-disabled commands; the received plan's 10-disabled count is retained as a non-authoritative observation.
Economic policy choices and terminal paths remain open; the nine profile decisions are explicitly OPEN with review questions and unselected option shapes.
The global state field contracts and value-delta class contracts are declared but remain GAP until types, equations, ownership, and reconciliation are independently checked.
Emergency zUSD shutdown is explicitly absent from the launch registry and requires a new profile decision before any re-entry.
The exact-subject BDD catalogue has 33 research-only workflows and 267 unimplemented scenario obligations; it has no executable evidence.
The exact-subject entrypoint audit maps 33 commands to 12 source surfaces; the source-level writer inventory has 25 open rows, 18 unmounted entries, and no declared production writer.
The verified repair descendant closes the scoped F1 orphan-recovery, F2 nested-finality ownership, and F3 hostile-path ingress defects with permanent negative tests; it remains research-only.
Dynamic reachability, generated code, credentials, and deployment wiring remain UNKNOWN and require a production-build audit.
The legacy ATDD contract is source-pinned to an older subject and is not a valid exact-subject G1 completion receipt.
The broader claims-registry gate fails on the exact base because claims[123] references missing tools/check_derivatives_authorization_matrix.py.
nonclaims: A closed registry alone does not implement, prove, mount, or test a command.
The G1 semantic mapping is research-only and cannot authorize settlement or production promotion.
The G1 BDD catalogue is scenario inventory only; it cannot substitute for executable tests, proofs, or mounted runtime evidence.
The G1 entrypoint audit is a static source inventory; it cannot establish dynamic reachability, generated-code coverage, no-bypass behavior, or a production writer.

nonclaims: Unit or differential tests alone do not establish mounting or production readiness.

tasks.title: Complete FormalGate

tasks.authority_boundary: Pinned Lean, ESSO, Tau, SMT, and replay checkers decide only their declared claims and premises.
failing_evidence: The global composition/refinement theorem is open.

tasks.title: Complete runtime refinement

nonclaims: Projection inventory or smoke tests do not establish total runtime refinement.

tasks.title: Complete mounted direct M6
tasks.invariant: Every enabled value-moving entrypoint reaches one publication capability and every disabled feature has no writer.

nonclaims: Static inventory and unit tests do not establish mounted no-bypass behavior.

tasks.title: Complete and integrate ZRPF
tasks.invariant: ZRPF proves the same transition as direct execution and admits roots through the same commit capability.
tasks.authority_boundary: ZRPF proves batch execution and has no finality, issuer, governance, or publication authority.
failing_evidence: The selected guest does not execute the complete shared transition.

nonclaims: Fixture receipts, partial recursion, or local smoke proofs do not establish ZRPF readiness.
